subject.title: fix: doctor clears legacy sandbox workspace state

question: Should sandbox workspace-copy enumeration remain a Doctor-only migration concern in this PR, or become part of the shared workspace-directory contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111791?
rationale: Both approaches repair the reported failure, but they establish different long-term ownership boundaries; source and proof do not establish which contract maintainers intend for non-Doctor callers.

options.title: Adopt Doctor-only discovery
options.body: Keep sandbox-copy enumeration confined to the explicit migration path and land one rebased version of this PR after confirming no shared caller needs those directories.

options.title: Adopt shared enumeration
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111791 if sandbox copies should be part of the general workspace-directory contract beyond Doctor repair.

options.title: Define a narrower common helper
options.body: Ask for a small shared primitive only if current callers show a genuine common need while preserving Doctor as the sole migration owner.

recommendation.title: Adopt Doctor-only discovery
recommendation.body: Keep sandbox-copy enumeration confined to the explicit migration path and land one rebased version of this PR after confirming no shared caller needs those directories.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue analysis identifies the runtime-versus-Doctor ownership mismatch that the decision must resolve.
